5684.rule: Allied fighters must end their turn on a cell adjacent to an enemy.
Unearthed Agony must be finished off first.

5662.rule: When an allied fighter attacks an enemy, no other allied fighter must attack that enemy for the duration of the fight.

Allied characters must finish off enemies using one of the following methods:
• poisons
• delayed damage
• pushback damage
• damage reflection
• traps
• glyphs
• runes
• summons

5682.rule: Allied fighters must use exactly one Movement Point per turn.
Allied fighters must not use the same action more than once on each of their turns.

5673.rule: Allied fighters must finish every turn on the same cell that they started on, for the duration of the fight.

Allied characters must finish off enemies using one of the following methods:
• poisons
• delayed damage
• pushback damage
• damage reflection
• traps
• glyphs
• runes
• summons

5663.rule: When an allied fighter inflicts damage in a certain element, they must only use that attack element for the duration of the fight.
Allied fighters must not use the same action more than once on each of their turns.
